action.reason: docs/guides/regression-gate.md still describes US-002's intermediate behavior (a capped red suite bypasses report check and review). US-003 now runs the report check and review on the last pass even when the suite is red. packages/nax/README.md states this correctly, so the two docs disagree. One-sentence fix: say a red suite goes to a fix while rounds remain, and on the last pass still runs the report check and review before residual adjudication. Everything else is fine to approve once this is corrected.

rationale: I confirmed the deferred minor against the diff. The guide contradicts the shipped final-pass exception and the README. It is a concrete, user-facing inaccuracy that should not ship, and fixing it is trivial.
